test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rohita offers a discount of 20% on the marked price of an object. Due to recession of market, she further offers a discount of 30% on its sale. What is the equivalent single discount percentage corresponding to these two successive discounts offers?
solution:
**Given:**

First discount (D₁)% = 20%

Second discount (D₂) = 30%

**Formula used:**

Equivalent discount% = D₁% + D₂% - (D₁ × D₂)/100

**Calculation:**

Equivalent discount% = D1&l
